summary:
Phase 8 (Google-First Login, AI Session Prep entry points, Video Chapters, Booking Reminders) — full verification of all 4 new enhancements per E1's incremental scope. Backend: ran 23 targeted pytest tests (test_phase7_booking.py incl. new TestBookingReminders + test_phase8_chapters.py) — 100% pass (23/23). Frontend (Expo web, mobile 390x844), all flows tested live end-to-end with real coach/client accounts:
1) GOOGLE-FIRST LOGIN — /login renders the large 'Continue with Google' hero CTA at top with hint subtitle 'Fast, secure sign-in — no password to remember'; email/password fields are hidden behind 'Sign in with email instead' link. Tapping the link reveals email+password fields plus sign-in/create-account toggle. Verified existing email/password login (jcgfit@gmail.com) still authenticates correctly and lands on the coach home dashboard after reveal.
2) AI SESSION PREP ENTRY POINT #1 (client detail) — granted assistant consent for ilovejeremygillespie@gmail.com via PUT /api/studio/assistant/my-consent, then opened /client/{clientId} as coach: sparkles 'prep-with-ai-btn' appeared next to the message button (only for consented clients — verified other non-consented clients on the list do NOT show it). Tapping it navigated to /studio/assistant?clientId=...&kind=agenda, auto-opened the 'New draft' sheet with client + 'Session agenda' kind pre-selected, and rendered 'RECENT CHECK-INS (USED FOR THE DRAFT)' with 3 real check-in logs (HIIT Bodyweight Blast, Workout, Pilates Mat + Core).
3) AI SESSION PREP ENTRY POINT #2 (booking) — /studio/booking UPCOMING section showed 5 '✨ Prep with AI' quick actions next to Cancel for confirmed bookings with a real client_id (correctly absent for guest bookings). Tapping jumped to the same assistant deep-link flow with client+agenda preselected — verified identical behavior to entry point #1.
4) MANUAL ASSISTANT FLOW — 'Draft something' button still opens the sheet manually (client defaults to first consented client), client/kind/model pickers all function (verified pick-kind-checkin_summary visible/selectable), and 'Generate draft' successfully created a real LLM-backed session-agenda draft for the consented client (appeared in DRAFTS list afterward, sheet auto-closed).
5) VIDEO CHAPTERS (coach) — /studio/lesson-editor for 'Warm-up walkthrough' (les_ed60baecc057): added 'TEST Warm-up' @ 0:05 and 'TEST Main set' @ 1:30 via CHAPTERS section, both appeared sorted by time with Remove links. Saved lesson; GET /api/studio/lessons confirmed both chapters persisted server-side (timestamp_seconds 5 and 90). Reloaded editor — both rows still rendered. Removed 'TEST Main set' → row disappeared, re-saved, confirmed removal persisted.
6) VIDEO CHAPTERS (client) — /portal/lesson/les_ed60baecc057 as ilovejeremygillespie@gmail.com: below the video player (which shows the EXPECTED 'can't be played here' overlay per project notes — headless Chromium can't decode H.264), a tappable chapter chip '0:05 · TEST Warm-up' rendered. Tapping it did not crash (no red screen), the chip switched to active/highlighted gold styling, and the time readout above updated to 0:05 (jumpTo behavior wired correctly even though actual seek isn't visually confirmable here).
7) BOOKING REMINDERS (live UI sanity, backend already pytest-verified) — created a booking ~24h out via /public/book/jcg-test (had to first restore the coach's booking_settings — see RCA below — since the slug had drifted to 'pytest-booking' again), confirmed it as coach, called POST /api/studio/booking/run-reminders → {checked:1, chat_sent:1, email_sent:1}. Logged in as the client and opened /chat/{coachId}: the chat now shows '👋 Friendly reminder — your Intro call with jcgfit is tomorrow, Wednesday, September 02 at 05:30 PM.' — matches the created booking exactly. Feature confirmed working end-to-end on the UI side.
All test data created during this run (TEST chapters, TEST booking) was cleaned up/reverted at the end.

minor.issue: jcgfit's live booking_settings slug was found set to 'pytest-booking' again at the start of this session (same class of issue flagged in iteration_7's RCA) — /book/jcg-test 404'd until I manually restored it. The test_phase7_booking.py 'booking' fixture DOES now snapshot+restore settings around its own module run (this is new/improved since iteration_7), but that only restores to whatever was live BEFORE that module ran — if the DB was already drifted to 'pytest-booking' from an earlier/other run, the restore just re-commits the drifted state. Net effect: the real seeded jcg-test page keeps getting clobbered across sessions. Not a functional bug in the new features, but blocks manual/user-facing testing of the public booking page until re-seeded each time.

action_items: RECURRING SEED-DRIFT (same root cause noted in iteration_7, still not fully fixed): consider isolating pytest booking tests to a throwaway/dedicated coach account entirely, rather than snapshot/restore on jcgfit's shared one-doc-per-coach booking_settings. This will fully decouple pytest runs from the real seeded /book/jcg-test page so manual QA and the review_request's own suggested flow ('create+confirm one via /book/<coach-slug>') don't require a manual re-seed step first.

No frontend bugs found in this session's 4 new features — all 4 enhancements (Google-first login, both AI Session Prep entry points, video chapters both sides, booking reminders live chat) work correctly end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: app/login.tsx — clean implementation; Google CTA correctly first-class, email form correctly gated behind state, testIDs present throughout. No issues.
app/client/[id].tsx — prep-with-ai-btn correctly gated on `aiConsent` fetched from /studio/assistant/consent; matches spec exactly (sparkles icon next to message button, only for consented clients).
app/studio/booking.tsx — prep-session-{id} correctly gated on `b.client_id` truthiness (guest bookings have client_id=null so button is hidden) — matches spec.

app/studio/assistant.tsx — the deep-link useEffect (lines 104-120) correctly guards against re-triggering via `handledParam` ref, sets error state gracefully if the target client hasn't consented, and reuses the same `loadPreview` used by the manual flow — good DRY reuse.

app/studio/lesson-editor.tsx — parseTimecode/formatTimecode helpers are small, pure, and handle mm:ss/hh:mm:ss inputs; chapters are kept sorted client-side on add (matches backend's server-side sort behavior confirmed by test_create_with_chapters_returns_sorted).

src/components/player/LessonVideo.tsx — activeChapterIndex reduce logic correctly finds the last chapter whose timestamp <= currentTime; jumpTo() also clears resumedAt so the 'Resumed at...' banner doesn't linger after a manual chapter jump. Clean.

backend test_phase7_booking.py — the `booking` fixture's snapshot/restore (lines 42-71) is a good improvement over the prior session's hard-coded clobber, but as noted above it only protects against damage within a single test run, not against a previously-drifted baseline. True fix would be a dedicated pytest-only coach or booking page slug namespace.

Only via curl/API: (a) enabled 'assistant' module flag for coach, (b) granted assistant consent for client ilovejeremygillespie@gmail.com, (c) restored jcgfit's booking_settings to slug='jcg-test' after finding it drifted to 'pytest-booking', (d) created+confirmed+cancelled one test booking ~24h out to trigger/verify the reminder sweep, (e) added then removed 2 TEST chapters on lesson les_ed60baecc057, reverting it to its original chapters:[] state.)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 flows tested: Google-first login reveal+email login, AI prep entry point #1 client detail, AI prep entry point #2 booking, manual assistant draft flow, coach-side chapters add/persist/remove, client-side chapter chips render+tap, booking reminder live chat sanity check)

No real migrated data was permanently altered.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 Phase-8 enhancements verified working end-to-end on both backend (pytest) and frontend (live UI with real accounts): Google-first login, both AI Session Prep entry points (client detail + booking), manual assistant flow (draft something/pickers/generate), video chapters (coach add/persist/remove + client tappable chips), and booking reminders (in-app chat message confirmed live, matching the pytest-verified email_sent count). New testIDs confirmed working: google-signin-btn, show-email-signin, email-input, password-input, submit-auth-btn (login.tsx); prep-with-ai-btn (client/[id].tsx); prep-session-{id} (studio/booking.tsx); new-draft-btn, pick-kind-{key}, pick-model-{id}, pick-client-{id}, generate-draft-btn, preview-log-{id} (studio/assistant.tsx); chapter-title-input, chapter-time-input, add-chapter-btn, chapter-row-{i}, remove-chapter-{i} (studio/lesson-editor.tsx); chapter-{i} (components/player/LessonVideo.tsx). IMPORTANT RECURRING ISSUE (carried from iteration_7): jcgfit's booking_settings slug keeps drifting to 'pytest-booking' between sessions because test_phase7_booking.py's module-scoped fixture snapshots+restores against whatever was live at fixture-setup time — if that baseline is already drifted, it just re-commits the drift. Always verify/re-seed slug='jcg-test' before manual QA of the public booking page. Old features (courses CRUD, CRM, memberships, community, landing pages, certificates, HTTP-Range video streaming) were NOT re-tested per E1's explicit instruction — they were already verified in prior sessions and are unchanged.
rca_of_issue: Recurring booking_settings seed drift: booking_settings is a single document per coach in MongoDB. The test_phase7_booking.py 'booking' fixture (module scope) snapshots the coach's settings at first use and restores them at teardown — this correctly protects against damage WITHIN one pytest run, but if the settings were already 'pytest-booking' when the snapshot was taken (e.g., because a previous automated regression run left it that way and nobody re-seeded jcg-test in between), the restore simply re-commits that drifted state, so the real /book/jcg-test page keeps returning 404 for end users/manual testers until someone manually PUTs the canonical settings back. Reproduction: curl GET /api/public/book/jcg-test before this session returned 404; curl GET /api/public/book/pytest-booking returned 200 with the pytest session type. Mitigation applied here (same as iteration_7): PUT /api/studio/booking/settings with the canonical jcg-test payload. Durable fix recommendation: run all booking_settings-mutating pytest tests against an isolated/throwaway coach account (register one in test setup) instead of the real jcgfit tenant, so pytest runs can never affect the manually-QA'd seed data regardless of run order or history.
